title: ServiceNow-utvecklare
description:
Vilka är vi?
Unibase är ett växande IT-företag med passion för att skapa värde för våra kunder genom smarta tekniska lösningar. Vi arbetar med spännande projekt och samarbetar med kunniga kollegor. Nu söker vi dig som vill vara med och göra skillnad genom att utveckla och förvalta lösningar i ServiceNow-plattformen.

Vi söker en erfaren ServiceNow-utvecklare till Unibase!
Som ServiceNow-utvecklare kommer du bland annat att:
Utveckla, konfigurera och anpassa lösningar i ServiceNow-plattformen
Arbeta med moduler som Incident, Problem, Change, CMDB och Service Catalog
Säkerställa att lösningarna följer best practice och kundens behov
Delta i projekt för implementation, integration och vidareutveckling av plattformen
Samarbeta med kollegor inom ITSM, utveckling och arkitektur

Du blir en viktig del av vårt och kundens team och bidrar till att leverera effektiva och framtidssäkra ITSM-lösningar.
Dina arbetsuppgifter kan bestå av följande (beroende på uppdrag):
Utveckling och konfiguration:
Skapa och anpassa workflows, business rules, UI policies och script
Implementera integrationer med externa system via API:er
Utveckla rapporter och dashboards för uppföljning och analys

Förvaltning och optimering:
Underhålla befintliga lösningar och säkerställa hög tillgänglighet
Felsöka och åtgärda problem i plattformen
Dokumentera konfigurationer och förändringar

Projekt och innovation:
Delta i design och implementation av nya moduler och funktioner
Bidra med idéer kring automatisering och effektivisering
Arbeta med uppgraderingar och nya versioner av ServiceNow

Meriterande erfarenheter
Det är positivt om du har erfarenhet av:
Certifieringar inom ServiceNow (t.ex. Certified System Administrator, Application Developer)
ITIL v4 eller liknande ramverk för IT-styrning
Scriptning i JavaScript och kunskap om REST API
Integrationer mot andra ITSM-verktyg eller affärssystem

Din bakgrund
Vi söker dig som har:
Minst 5 års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet inom ServiceNow-utveckling
God förståelse för ITSM-processer och ServiceNow-arkitektur
Eftergymnasial utbildning inom IT eller motsvarande erfarenhet
Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både muntligt och skriftligt

Varför ska du bli en del av vår familj?
Vårt engagemang för mångfald och inkludering
Vi värdesätter mångfald och strävar efter att skapa en inkluderande arbetsmiljö. Alla kvalificerade sökande uppmuntras att ansöka, oavsett kön, ålder, etnicitet, religion, funktionsvariation eller sexuell läggning. Vi tror att olika perspektiv berikar vårt team och vår verksamhet.

title: System Engineer to ALIARO
description:
Do you enjoy solving practical problems where hardware and software meet? ALIARO is looking for a Systems Engineer who wants to take responsibility for building, integrating, and improving test systems in a hands-on environment.
About the job
This is a direct recruitment, which means that the recruitment process takes place through Bravura and you are employed directly by the ALIARO
About the company
ALIARO was founded in 2014 with the ambition to deliver innovative and dependable testing solutions to clients across a wide range of industries worldwide. Since then, the company has grown into a leading provider of modular and reusable test solutions designed to adapt to changing technical and business needs.
The team consists of experienced engineers with deep expertise in testing and measurement. Continuous skill development is a natural part of the work, and ALIARO maintains close partnerships with leading hardware and software providers such as National Instruments (NI). Through active involvement in industry organizations like ASAM, the company stays ahead of evolving standards and technologies.
ALIARO is a smaller organization with short decision paths, where collaboration is close-knit and everyone has a clear impact on both projects and customers.
Tasks and responsibilities
As a Systems Engineer at ALIARO you work closely with both hardware and software, focusing on integrating, configuring, and developing test systems. The role is practical and varied, suited for someone who enjoys understanding how systems work in detail and taking ownership from setup to verification. You will troubleshoot across HW/SW boundaries, develop automation tools, and contribute to structured technical documentation.
Key responsibilities include:
• Integrating and configuring test and measurement systems
• Developing scripts and tools in Python for automation and workflows
• Working with NI platforms such as LabVIEW, VeriStand, PXI, and cRIO
• Troubleshooting and resolving issues across hardware and software
• Verifying systems using electronics and PCB knowledge
• Writing clear technical documentation and following established processes
Education, experience and personal characteristics
• Previous experience as a Systems Engineer, Test Engineer, or Electronics Engineer
• Solid understanding of electronics and PCB fundamentals
• Hands-on experience with NI software, especially LabVIEW and VeriStand
• Good knowledge of Python for automation and integration
• Experience working across hardware and software in practical environments
• Very good communication skills in English
We are looking for someone that is self-driven and likes to take responsibility for their own work, from identifying a problem to delivering a solution. You prefer practical, hands-on tasks and are comfortable switching between different technical challenges. You communicate in a clear and straightforward way and enjoy working closely with others in a small team where priorities can change, and decisions are made quickly.

title: Principal Embedded Software Engineer to Markem-Imaje
employer: ANTS Akademiskt Nätverk av Tekniska Studenter AB
description:
Om jobbet
Markem-Imaje is a trusted world manufacturer of product identification and traceability solutions, offering a full range of reliable and innovative inkjet, thermal transfer, laser, print and label application systems. Markem-Imaje delivers fully integrated solutions that enable product quality and safety, regulatory and retailer compliance, better product recalls and improved manufacturing processes.
Markem-Imaje Sweden in Gothenburg is something as unusual as a small innovation and development hub with a startup mindset within an established global company.
Our mission is to lead the development of new innovative products and solutions, from concept to production with the freedom to use the work methods we find most efficient. We love what we do, and we have help from the global organization we are a part of.
The Role
We are seeking an experienced, skilled, and self-driven Principal Embedded Software Engineer, with a system mindset and an interest in exciting technology. You, just like we do, appreciate working with the complete development cycle, from idea to finished product, via proof of concept and implementation, using effective methods and tools.
In this role, you will:

Develop control software in C++ and Go, as well as associated software architecture, in cooperation with developers from both the local office and other offices within the global organization.


Bring a system level view, understanding how the software interacts with the hardware, how different customers use the products, and using that knowledge in architectural and prioritization work.


Be part of an experienced and passionate team that develops not only software but also electronics and mechanics, with the possibility to share ideas, experience, and knowledge.


Influence design choices within all development disciplines.

What You Will Do
You will develop controller software in C++ and Golang, as well as associated tests, for a controller running embedded Linux that cooperates with other components within the printer, such as MCUs and FPGA. You will interface with other engineering disciplines, engineering teams, stakeholders, and customers to understand the application space and business requirements and use that understanding to influence technology selection and decisions, both within the company and together with major customers.
Beyond day-to-day development, you will:

Lead and facilitate high level software estimation to support business planning activities.


Mentor and teach other software engineers in improving their skills.


Lead design reviews and drive improvements in design and code quality produced by internal and external engineers.


Drive continuous improvement in source control and continuous integration by staying up to date with the latest industry practices and tools.


Test and fault find code written by yourself and by others.


Throughout, you'll work closely with the team to achieve shared goals, and influence and inspire others through personal credibility.
What You Need To Have
Bachelor's or Master's degree with significant professional experience developing software, and a demonstrable record of delivering high-quality embedded software for end user products from requirements analysis to delivery.


Expert in writing portable, cross-platform, modern C++ code, with solid experience in Go/Golang and expert knowledge of real time operating system (RTOS) concepts.


Expert architecture and design skills, functional decomposition, architectural viewpoints, UML/SysML, and design patterns, together with advanced implementation skills such as multithreaded and distributed systems programming and on target debugging.


Demonstrable experience in a technical leadership role within a software team and for external engineering resources, including code reviews, design reviews, and mentoring.


Advanced knowledge of electronics, including microcontrollers, memory and peripherals, and experience reading schematics and using oscilloscopes/logic analyzers.


Swedish, French, Italian, or Polish language skills would be beneficial but are not a requirement.
If you believe you match our values and have the experience we're looking for, then apply as we review applications on a rolling basis! We can't wait to hear from you!

You’ll be responsible for writing requirement-based tests, maintaining code quality to AUTOSAR standards, ensuring stability of the Component within Continuous Integration systems and handling bug mitigation, if such will be found.

Automotive industry

title: Embedded Software Developer - General Lighting
description:
LumenRadio is a high-tech company with the vision of replacing all cables in the world. We have been leading the wireless transformation within the lighting industry since 2008, where our technology is being used every day in the largest TV and Movie productions in Hollywood, at the Coachella festival, and the Eurovision Song Contest. Our patented technologies deliver unprecedented reliability for the most business-critical applications, and our products are now also used in permanent indoor and outdoor lighting installations, as well as in building automation systems.
Replacing cables in lighting control systems with wireless communication makes installations easier, more flexible and more cost-efficient. With rising demands for energy efficiency, wireless lighting control has become a key enabler, making intelligent control possible even where traditional cabling is not.
In our General Lighting team, we work with W-DALI and AirGlow to bring reliable wireless lighting control to real-world environments, using existing DALI systems and without the need for cabling. You will be part of our R&D organization, where we continuously develop and refine wireless communication technology, and are currently focused on building the next-generation platform that enables even higher performance in our wireless solutions.
Your future
We are looking for our next Embedded Software Developer to join our product development team within General Lighting. In this role, you will play an important role in new development projects as well as maintenance assignments on system level, e.g. drawing up requirement specifications, pre-studies, proposals, system design, system testing (QA) and acceptance testing. You will also plan and execute product/project plans and drive process improvements.
An important part of our approach to product development is having a deep understanding of our customers' challenges and closely understanding the environment in which our products are used. As a developer in the team, we expect you to be driven by a desire to understand the industry and participate in technical customer dialogues and support cases when needed. You will balance a deep technical interest and knowledge with the willingness to learn about domain specific requirements, standards, certifications etc.
As part of maintaining a close dialogue with our customers and partners, we expect you to participate in trade shows and engineering meet-ups around the world approximately 2-3 times per year.
About you

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent


Experience in delivering high-quality embedded C firmware


Experience with Python, e.g. for testing purposes


Experience in CI/CD and measuring electronics


A genuine passion for technology, demonstrated by curiosity and a desire to stay informed about industry trends


Fluency in English, written and spoken


While it's beneficial to have prior knowledge of, it's not essential as you'll have the opportunity to learn about:

networking (IPv6, OSI model etc.)


wireless networking (Bluetooth/BLE, Zigbee, WiFi, LoRa, Thread, 6LoWPAN, NB-IoT, 5G etc.)


different lighting- & industry protocols, such as DALI, KNX, BACnet, Modbus, etc.


Our tech stack

Whatever OS and editor that make you productive


Arm-gcc, Git, GNU Make


Robot Framework, GitLab and GitLab CI


Bluetooth, SPI, UART, our own meshing network stack Mira


We are looking for people who share our values – Reliability, Innovation, Simplicity and Energy.
Diversity and culture
We are on a mission to replace all cables in the world, and we are looking for you who share our passion for cutting-edge technology! We value diversity and welcome different-minded professionals who are committed to our ambitious goals. We warmly welcome and encourage job applications from people of all backgrounds and genders.
If you need any adjustments to support you with your application, just let us know by emailing nelly.bertilsson@lumenradio.com.

We offer good job security through agreements and insurance, paid parental leave, holiday leave, and attractive pension plans📃

Yearly personal development allowance - For your brain and creativity🧠


Free access to the gym in the same building🏋🏽‍♂️


Flexible working hours⌚
